Account: regional power utility (transmission + control centers). Very prescriptive security posture — no external egress allowed from control plane. Interested in Redwood Private deployed to their COLO racks; eventual desire for full air-gapped on-prem bundle.

Highlights:
- Primary workload: operator assist and incident triage (low-latency alerts + concise runbook suggestions).
- Need deterministic latency SLA for control-room queries (p99 < 150ms for short prompts; throughput moderate ~150 qps during peak).
- Cost sensitivity: secondary to security but expect tight capex procurement (multi-year license).
- Model preference: smaller tuned open models with quantization; must support signed model artifacts, reproducible hashes.
- Routing/fallback: prefer single on-prem variant; fallback to local cached weights only. No hosted failover allowed by policy.
